sloka: सुषेणं श्वशुरं वीरं तारं च बलिनां वरम् ।कुमुदं चैव दुर्धर्षं नीलं चैव महाबलम् ।। ७.४०.४ ॥
transliteration: suṣeṇaṁ śvaśuraṁ vīraṁ tāraṁ ca balināṁ varam ।kumudaṁ caiva durdharṣaṁ nīlaṁ caiva mahābalam ।। 7.40.4 ॥

translations.english: Also see the brave Sushena, your father-in-law, Tara, the best among the strong, and the unassailable Kumuda, and Nila of great strength.
